notes: Offline GitLab peer-review evaluations. Use supplied fixtures/fake glab only; no live comment, label, approval, merge, resolution, source or push effects. Confirm independent evidence collection, readable status, caller restrictions and separate immutable collection/publication receipts.

evals.name: independent-review-no-thread-inspection
evals.prompt: Peer review this GitLab MR and do not post anything: https://gitlab.agodadev.io/Activities/activity-marketing-spark/-/merge_requests/352
evals.expected_output: The run fetches MR metadata and diff, uses only the diff plus material MR-body description/evidence/test result summary, does not inspect review threads, drafts only independent peer-review comments, and persists a complete versioned JSON record.
assertions: material-input-boundary: report states that only diff plus MR-body description, evidence, and test result summary were considered material
no-thread-inspection: report states that reviewer, bot, and CodeBuddy threads were not inspected because thread resolution was not requested
no-thread-actions: report does not classify review comments, draft review-thread replies, or expose apply-suggestion action IDs
draft-only: report states explicitly that no reply, resolve, approval, merge, suggestion apply, or push was performed
review-persisted: report includes the absolute path of a schema-version-1 review JSON record under the selected .peer-review store

evals.name: mr-body-template-filter
evals.prompt: Review this GitLab MR with a large MR-body template and tell me whether there are correctness or maintainability issues. Do not post: https://gitlab.agodadev.io/bookingapi/booking-creation/-/merge_requests/9106
evals.expected_output: The run separates filled MR-body description/evidence/test summary from empty template/checklist text, validates any peer findings with evidence, and avoids treating generic template content as material.
assertions: template-filtered: report excludes empty checklists and boilerplate from material MR-body evidence
evidence-selected: report summarizes only concrete description, evidence, or test result summary as material
bounded-validation: report validates findings with focused commands or marks them unverified when proof exceeds the effort cap
draft-only: report states that no GitLab or source-code write was performed
complete-record: persisted JSON contains identity, reviewer, MR snapshot, sources, and the complete review result

evals.name: large-frontend-review-token-discipline
evals.prompt: Peer review this GitLab MR for correctness and maintainability. Keep the effort reasonable and do not post anything: https://gitlab.agodadev.io/full-stack/monoliths/agoda-com-spa-mobile/-/merge_requests/45569
evals.expected_output: The run performs independent review from diff plus MR-body material, uses narrow validation before broad tests, separates rejected hypotheses, and drafts only survivor comments.
assertions: bounded-effort: report explains the chosen validation effort and avoids broad test runs unless justified
unique-peer-findings-section: report includes unique peer findings or explicitly states none survived validation
rejected-hypotheses-section: report includes rejected hypotheses or explicitly states none were rejected
survivors-only-in-drafts: inline publication contains only independently confirmed actionable findings; unverified questions remain in the report
atomic-review-record: the completed review is stored at .peer-review/<encoded-project>/<iid>.json and is usable by the summary renderer

evals.name: model-effort-label
evals.prompt: Peer review https://gitlab.example.com/group/project/-/merge_requests/123 using model gpt-6.1 sol with High thinking effort. Use mocked GitLab responses for this offline evaluation: the head stays unchanged and the MR has label backend. Capture the proposed API request without sending it.
evals.expected_output: The run proposes adding peer-reviewed::gpt-6.1 sol--High after completing the review, preserves the backend label, verifies the head and returned label, and sends no live writes.
assertions: exact-label: proposed add_labels value is peer-reviewed::gpt-6.1 sol--High
additive-update: request uses add_labels rather than replacing all labels
head-check: label is skipped if the current head differs from the reviewed SHA
offline: no live GitLab writes are performed

evals.name: label-metadata-unavailable
evals.prompt: Peer review https://gitlab.example.com/group/project/-/merge_requests/123 in an offline evaluation. The runtime and caller provide no model or thinking-effort metadata. Explain how labeling is handled.
evals.expected_output: The run reports missing label metadata and skips the label without guessing from the example or MR content.
assertions: no-guessed-metadata: neither model nor effort is invented
label-gap: missing metadata and skipped labeling are reported
offline: no live GitLab writes are performed

evals.name: readable-clean-ci-separate
evals.prompt: Use dev-peer-review offline with fixture MR https://gitlab.example.com/group/project/-/merge_requests/123, reviewed head 0123456789abcdef, complete review verification, no findings, failed CI and label attachment denied. Return the chat result; do not call live GitLab.
evals.expected_output: A readable clean heading, exact SHA, zero counts, complete review verification, failed CI and label gap. Publication and labeling are skipped; no embedded JSON.
assertions: heading is Peer review: No actionable issues found
failed CI and label error do not make review verification incomplete
chat includes absolute stored record path; raw JSON remains local
offline restrictions prevent all external writes

evals.name: incomplete-with-confirmed-and-unverified
evals.prompt: Use offline fixture MR !123 at 0123456789abcdef. Required focused proof is unavailable; one separate issue was confirmed by a reproduction and another remains speculative. Render the result and proposed publication using fake glab only.
evals.expected_output: Incomplete heading with one confirmed issue; the gap and unverified issue stay visible, and only the proven issue is eligible inline.
assertions: incomplete heading takes precedence
one confirmed issue and correct blocking count
unverified issue excluded from inline posts and confirmed count
missing/invalid diff position stays in summary with honest location

evals.name: incomplete-zero
evals.prompt: Use offline fixture MR !123 at 0123456789abcdef. Review verification could not finish and no actionable issue is yet confirmed. Return a readable report and capture a proposed summary through fake glab.
evals.expected_output: Peer review: Incomplete — 0 confirmed issues, explicit gaps, no clean conclusion and no inline findings.
assertions: zero confirmed issues never implies clean when verification is incomplete
summary explicitly explains missing proof
no speculative inline comment

evals.name: same-and-new-sha-publication
evals.prompt: Using only local fake glab, publish an incomplete fixture review, retry it, complete it at the same SHA, then review a new SHA where the same independently reconfirmed finding moved by one line. Inspect receipts and render the chat result.
evals.expected_output: Same-SHA retry reuses its summary; completion updates it; new head creates another summary; unchanged finding is not duplicated.
assertions: exactly one summary per reviewed SHA and preserved earlier history
same original inline finding reused across heads
chat has observed summary and inline links
collection record bytes remain unchanged

evals.name: restrictions-and-parent-report
evals.prompt: Act as an implementation parent receiving a separate peer reviewer native result. The caller requested draft-only. Use local fixtures only. Return the actual parent chat reply, not a description of a future reply.
evals.expected_output: The parent returns readable status, SHA, counts, gaps, absolute stored record path and explicit skipped publication/label status. No network write is attempted.
assertions: caller restriction forwarded alongside unchanged dispatch identity
both labels and original comments skipped
parent chat includes readable review rather than only recordPath/JSON
separate native execution and exact-head gate remain required

evals.name: uncertain-and-drift
evals.prompt: Using fake glab only, lose an inline POST response after the server stored it, then retry. Separately, change the head after one observed inline effect and before summary publication. Also model a timeout with no observable native receipt.
evals.expected_output: Lost response is reconciled without duplicate; drift stops remaining writes while retaining observed receipts; absent uncertain receipt blocks retry.
assertions: native author/body/position/ID evidence required for success
no duplicate POST after lost response
head refetched immediately before each effect
uncertain absent effect is not assumed failed
malformed state/identity fails before effects

evals.name: concise-report-and-actual-posted-receipts
evals.prompt: Using fake glab only, review fixture MR !123 with one confirmed issue and detailed proof/commands/rejected hypotheses. Reuse its original inline at a new head after changing the current title, then model confirmed inline creation followed by a lost summary response. Return the concise parent chat result and captured MR summary.
evals.expected_output: Short actionable findings and material gaps remain visible; detailed proof/commands/rejected hypotheses stay inline/local. Chat includes Posted to MR with actual receipt-derived summary headline and current-review inline titles/native links, including an old reused title. Partial/unconfirmed outcomes are explicit. MR summary excludes Posted to MR bookkeeping.
assertions: default output omits full trigger/proof/successful-command/rejected-hypothesis dumps without hiding material gaps
Posted to MR uses observed receipt body labels and native links rather than changed drafts
unrelated historical findings and full posted bodies are excluded
confirmed inline with unconfirmed summary remains explicitly partial
skipped/no-post/error/unconfirmed states are accurate
external link-label brackets/backslashes are escaped and quick actions remain inert
parent preserves concise report and Posted to MR section; MR summary does not recursively include it
